risks.reason: It modifies rental and decoration term calculations if the premises and facilities are delayed in being exchanged.
It requires Party B to return the leased house to Party A at the end of the lease.
The lessee must bear premises administration fees and utility costs incurred during the rental term.
The lessor must repair damage to the premises and attached facilities and pay the related expenses.
The lessor must repair the premises and attached facilities and pay the related expenses.
Party B has priority to buy the premises if Party A intends to sell them.
This clause governs whether Party B may sublease all or part of the premises, requiring Party A’s written consent.
It grants Party B priority to continue the lease over other parties on the same conditions.
Party A guarantees that the premises and attached facilities and equipment are in good condition.
The lessor is responsible for keeping the leased house and attached facilities in sound condition.
It imposes a penalty when the lessee terminates the lease early without the lessor’s consent.
